entries.english: Keep roots well drained; water matters during flowering.
entries.zu: Izimpande mazihlale emhlabathini okhipha amanzi kahle; amanzi abalulekile ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza.
entries.st: Boloka metso mobung o ntshang metsi hantle; metsi a bohlokwa nakong ya ho thunya.
entries.ts: Tiyisisa leswaku mati ya huma kahle laha timitsu ti nga kona; mati i ya nkoka loko ku huma swiluva.
entries.ve: Midzi i dzule mavuni a bvumisaho maḓi zwavhuḓi; maḓi ndi a ndeme musi hu tshi khou vha na maluvha.

entries.english: KZN sequence: earlier Fuerte (May–Nov), middle Hass (Aug–Dec), later Ryan (Nov–Feb). These seasons overlap. Buy labelled grafted trees; confirm rootstock and pollination partners.
entries.zu: Ukulandelana kwase-KZN: i-Fuerte yokuqala ({month5}–{month11}), i-Hass yaphakathi ({month8}–{month12}), i-Ryan yakamuva ({month11}–{month2}). Lezi zikhathi ziyagqagqana. Thenga izihlahla ezixhunyelelwe ezinamalebula; qinisekisa isiphunzi nezinhlobo ezihambisanayo zempova.
entries.st: Tatellano ya KZN: Fuerte ya pele ({month5}–{month11}), Hass ya bohareng ({month8}–{month12}), Ryan ya morao ({month11}–{month2}). Dinako tsena di a kopana. Reka difate tse hlomathisitsweng tse nang le dileibole; netefatsa kutu ya motso le balekane ba ho tsamaisa peo.
entries.ts: Ku landzelana ka KZN: Fuerte yo sungula ({month5}–{month11}), Hass ya le xikarhini ({month8}–{month12}), Ryan ya le ndzhaku ({month11}–{month2}). Tinguva leti ta hlangana. Xava mirhi leyi tlhomiweke leyi nga ni tilebulu; tiyisisa nsinya wa timitsu ni mirhi leyi fambisanaka eku hangalaseni ka mpova.
entries.ve: U tevhekana ha KZN: Fuerte ya u thoma ({month5}–{month11}), Hass ya vhukati ({month8}–{month12}), Ryan ya nga murahu ({month11}–{month2}). Zwifhinga izwi zwi a dzhena kha zwiṅwe. Rengani miri yo ṱumetshedzwaho i re na ḽebuḽu; khwaṱhisedzani mudzi wa mutheo na miri i tshimbidzanaho kha u phaḓaladza luvhanda.

entries.english: Warm, frost-free conditions and dependable water are needed. Keep a replacement follower after the fruiting stem is removed.
entries.zu: Kudingeka indawo efudumele, engenasithwathwa namanzi athembekile. Gcina ihlumela elizolandela lapho isiqu esithelile sisusiwe.
entries.st: Ho hlokahala mofuthu, sebaka se se nang serame se qetellang ka leqhwa le metsi a tshepahalang. Boloka lehlomela le tla nka sebaka ka mora ho tlosa kutu e behileng ditholwana.
entries.ts: Ku laveka ndhawu yo kufumela leyi nga riki na gwitsi ni mati lama kumekaka hi ku tiyiseka. Siya xihluke lexi nga ta siva xirhabyana lexi susiwaka endzhaku ko tswala mihandzu.
entries.ve: Hu ṱoḓea fhethu hu dudelaho hu si na ṅwando na maḓi a fulufhedzeaho. Vhulungani tshiṋangi tshi ḓo dzhielaho vhudzulo tsinde ḽo bviswaho musi ḽo no aṋwa.

entries.english: Cooler KZN: Williams; warmer valleys: Grand Nain; windy coast: Chinese Cavendish. Buy clean planting material. These are climate choices, not early/middle/late seasons.
entries.zu: E-KZN epholile: Williams; ezigodini ezifudumele: Grand Nain; ogwini olunomoya: Chinese Cavendish. Thenga izinto zokutshala ezihlanzekile. Lokhu ukukhetha ngokwesimo sezulu, akuzona izikhathi zokuqala/zaphakathi/zakamuva.
entries.st: KZN e phodileng: Williams; dikgohlong tse futhumetseng: Grand Nain; lebopong le nang le moya: Chinese Cavendish. Reka thepa ya ho jala e hlwekileng. Tsena ke dikgetho tsa maemo a lehodimo, ha se dinako tsa pele/bohareng/morao.
entries.ts: Eka KZN leyi titimelaka: Williams; eka minkova yo kufumela: Grand Nain; eribuweni leri nga ni moya: Chinese Cavendish. Xava switirhisiwa swo byala leswi baseke. Leyi i nhlawulo wa maxelo, a hi tinguva ta le ku sunguleni/xikarhini/ndzhaku.
entries.ve: Kha KZN hu rotholelaho: Williams; kha mikovhe i dudelaho: Grand Nain; khunzikhunzini ya lwanzhe hu re na muya: Chinese Cavendish. Rengani zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha zwo kunaho. Izwi ndi u nanga u ya nga kilima, a si zwifhinga zwa u thoma/vhukati/murahu.

entries.english: Avoid frost and waterlogging. Honey Gold needs male and female plants; Sunrise Solo is hermaphrodite.
entries.zu: Gwema isithwathwa nokugcwala kwamanzi. I-Honey Gold idinga izitshalo zesilisa nezesifazane; i-Sunrise Solo inezitho zombili zobulili.
entries.st: Qoba serame se bakang leqhwa le mobu o tletseng metsi. Honey Gold e hloka dimela tsa botona le botshehadi; Sunrise Solo e na le ditho tsa botona le botshehadi semeleng se le seng.
entries.ts: Papalata gwitsi ni misava leyi taleke mati. Honey Gold yi lava swimilana swa xinuna ni swa xisati; Sunrise Solo yi ni swirho swa xinuna ni swa xisati eka ximilana xinwe.
entries.ve: Iledzani ṅwando na mavu o ḓalaho maḓi. Honey Gold i ṱoḓa zwimela zwa tshiduna na tshisadzi; Sunrise Solo i na zwipiḓa zwa vhuduna na vhusadzi kha tshimela tshithihi.

entries.english: Planning choice for warm sites: Sunrise Solo. Confirm plant sex/form with the nursery.
entries.zu: Okukhethelwe ukuhlela izindawo ezifudumele: Sunrise Solo. Qinisekisa ubulili/uhlobo lwesitshalo enkulisa yezitshalo.
entries.st: Kgetho ya moralo bakeng sa dibaka tse futhumetseng: Sunrise Solo. Netefatsa bong/sebopeho sa semela le keretjhe ya dimela.
entries.ts: Nhlawulo wa ku pulana eka tindhawu to kufumela: Sunrise Solo. Tiyisisa rimbewu/xivumbeko xa ximilana ni ndhawu yo kurisela swimilana.
entries.ve: Nḓila ya u pulana kha fhethu hu dudelaho: Sunrise Solo. Khwaṱhisedzani mbeu/tshivhumbeo tsha tshimela na hune ha alusiwa zwimela.

entries.english: Nuts: record nut-in-shell separately from kernels.
entries.zu: Amantongomane: bhala amantongomane asesemagobolondweni ngokwehlukana nezikhwebu.
entries.st: Matokomane: ngola a ntseng a le dikgapetleng ka thoko ho dithollo tse ntshitsweng.
entries.ts: Timanga: rhekhoda leti nga ha riki ni swikhamba ti hambanile ni tindzoho leti susiweke swikhamba.
entries.ve: Nḓuhu: rekhodani dzi re kha maganda dzo fhambana na tshikoro tsho bviswaho maganda.

entries.english: Match the cultivar to the microclimate; avoid hard frost and poorly drained ground.
entries.zu: Khetha uhlobo oluhambisana nesimo sezulu sendawo encane; gwema isithwathwa esinzima nomhlabathi ongakhiphi amanzi kahle.
entries.st: Nyalanya mofuta le boemo ba lehodimo ba sebaka se senyane; qoba serame se matla se bakang leqhwa le mobu o sa ntsheng metsi hantle.
entries.ts: Hlawula muxaka lowu fambisanaka ni maxelo ya ndhawu yoleyo; papalata gwitsi lerikulu ni misava leyi nga humesiki mati kahle.
entries.ve: Fananyisani lushaka lwa tshimela u ya nga kilima ya fhethu honoho; iledzani ṅwando muhulwane na mavu a sa bvumisaho maḓi zwavhuḓi.

entries.english: Collect fallen nuts frequently, dehusk promptly and dry with clean ventilation. Keep poultry and manure away from harvesting nuts.
entries.zu: Qoqa njalo amantongomane awile, susa amakhoba masinyane bese womisa endaweni ehlanzekile engenisa umoya. Izinkukhu nomquba makuqhele lapho kuvunwa khona amantongomane.
entries.st: Bokella matokomane a weleng kgafetsa, tlosa makgapetla a kantle kapele mme o a omise sebakeng se hlwekileng se kenang moya. Suthisetsa dikgoho le moitedi hole le matokomane a kotulwang.
entries.ts: Hlengeleta timanga leti weke nkarhi na nkarhi, susa makamba ya le handle hi ku hatlisa kutani u ti omisa endhawini yo basa leyi nghenaka moya. Tiyisisa leswaku tihuku ni manyoro a swi le kusuhi ni timanga leti tshoveriwaka.
entries.ve: Kuvhanganyani nḓuhu dzo waho tshifhinga tshoṱhe, bvisani maganda a nnḓa nga u ṱavhanya ni dzi omise kha fhethu ho kunaho hu re na muya. Kuku na manyoro zwi dzule kule na nḓuhu dzi khou kaṋiwaho.

entries.english: KZN coastal 90–300 m shortlist: Beaumont (695), Purvis (294), Makai (800), 660. Confirm site elevation and current pollination/maturity advice.
entries.zu: Uhlu olufushane logu lwase-KZN oluku-90–300 m: Beaumont (695), Purvis (294), Makai (800), 660. Qinisekisa ukuphakama kwendawo nezeluleko zamanje zempova/ukuvuthwa.
entries.st: Lenane le lekgutshwane la lebopo la KZN la 90–300 m: Beaumont (695), Purvis (294), Makai (800), 660. Netefatsa bophahamo ba sebaka le keletso ya hajwale ya ho tsamaisa peo/ho butswa.
entries.ts: Nxaxamelo wo koma wa ribuwa ra KZN ra 90–300 m: Beaumont (695), Purvis (294), Makai (800), 660. Tiyisisa ku tlakuka ka ndhawu ni switsundzuxo swa sweswi swa mpova/ku vupfa.
entries.ve: Mutevhe mupfufhi wa khunzikhunzini ya lwanzhe ya KZN ya 90–300 m: Beaumont (695), Purvis (294), Makai (800), 660. Khwaṱhisedzani vhunṱha ha fhethu na nyeletshedzo dza zwino dza luvhanda/u vhibva.

entries.english: Check frost, drainage and flowering-season disease pressure. Heat and sunburn sensitivity differ between cultivars.
entries.zu: Hlola isithwathwa, ukuphuma kwamanzi nobungozi bezifo ngesikhathi sokuqhakaza. Ukuzwela ekushiseni nasekushisweni yilanga kuyehluka ngezinhlobo.
entries.st: Hlahloba serame se bakang leqhwa, phallo ya metsi mobung le kotsi ya mafu nakong ya ho thunya. Kutlo ya mocheso le ho tjheswa ke letsatsi e fapana ka mefuta.
entries.ts: Kambela gwitsi, ku huma ka mati ni khombo ya mavabyi hi nkarhi wa swiluva. Ku khumbeka hi ku hisa ni ku hisiwa hi dyambu swa hambana hi mixaka.
entries.ve: Ṱolani ṅwando, u bva ha maḓi na khombo ya malwadze nga tshifhinga tsha maluvha. U kwamea nga mufhiso na u swa nga ḓuvha zwi fhambana nga tshaka.

entries.english: ARC identifies Tommy Atkins and Kent among more heat/sunburn-tolerant options; Sensation and Keitt are more susceptible. Confirm local harvest dates before choosing a succession.
entries.zu: I-ARC ibala i-Tommy Atkins ne-Kent phakathi kwezinhlobo ezibekezelela ukushisa/ukushiswa yilanga kangcono; i-Sensation ne-Keitt zithinteka kalula. Qinisekisa izinsuku zokuvuna zendawo ngaphambi kokukhetha izinhlobo ezilandelanayo.
entries.st: ARC e kenyelletsa Tommy Atkins le Kent mefuteng e mamellang mocheso/ho tjheswa ke letsatsi ho feta; Sensation le Keitt di ameha habonolo. Netefatsa matsatsi a kotulo a lehae pele o kgetha tatellano.
entries.ts: ARC yi katsa Tommy Atkins na Kent eka mixaka leyi tiyiselaka ku hisa/ku hisiwa hi dyambu ku antswa; Sensation na Keitt swi khumbeka ngopfu. Tiyisisa masiku ya ntshovelo ya ndhawu u nga si hlawula mixaka leyi landzelelanaka.
entries.ve: ARC i vhala Tommy Atkins na Kent kha tshaka dzi konḓelelaho mufhiso/u swa nga ḓuvha khwine; Sensation na Keitt dzi a kwamea nga maanḓa. Khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha a u kaṋa a henefho musi ni sa athu nanga u tevhekana ha tshaka.

entries.english: Check the actual cultivar, rootstock, winter chilling and compatible pollen source before buying. A warm or cold climate-zone label alone does not establish these conditions.
entries.zu: Ngaphambi kokuthenga, hlola uhlobo lwangempela, isiphunzi, ukubanda kwasebusika nomthombo wempova ohambisanayo. Ilebula lendawo yesimo sezulu efudumele noma ebandayo lodwa alikuqinisekisi lokhu.
entries.st: Pele o reka, hlahloba mofuta wa nnete, kutu ya motso, ho bata ha mariha le mohlodi wa peo o dumellanang. Leibole ya sebaka se futhumetseng kapa se batang feela ha e netefatse maemo ana.
entries.ts: U nga si xava, kambela muxaka wa xiviri, nsinya wa timitsu, ku titimela ka xixika ni xihlovo xa mpova lexi fambisanaka na wona. Lebulu ya ndhawu ya maxelo yo kufumela kumbe yo titimela yi ri yoxe a yi tiyisisi swiyimo leswi.
entries.ve: Musi ni sa athu renga, ṱolani lushaka lwa vhukuma, mudzi wa mutheo, u rothola ha vhuriha na tshiko tsha luvhanda tshi tshimbidzanaho nalwo. Ḽebuḽu ya dzingu ḽi dudelaho kana ḽi rotholelaho i yoṱhe a i khwaṱhisedzi nyimele idzi.

entries.english: Afri-Star is an ARC-bred low-chill candidate with a stated 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit requirement; its December–January dates were obtained at Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape and need local checking elsewhere. Granny Smith has an Elgin first-pick reference in late March; SAPO names Golden Delicious or Hillieri as pollen partners. These are separate cultivar references, not a continuous picking season or a warm KZN recommendation. Confirm current nursery stock and local performance.
entries.zu: I-Afri-Star iwuhlobo olungadingi ukubanda okuningi olwakhiwe yi-ARC, olunesidingo esibhalwe esingu-300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; izinsuku zalo zika-{month12}–{month1} zatholakala e-Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape futhi zidinga ukuqinisekiswa endaweni kwenye indawo. I-Granny Smith inereferensi yokuqala ukukha e-Elgin ngasekupheleni kuka-{month3}; i-SAPO ibala i-Golden Delicious noma i-Hillieri njengezinhlobo zempova ezihambisanayo. Lezi izinkomba zezinhlobo ezehlukene, akusona isikhathi esiqhubekayo sokukha noma isincomo se-KZN efudumele. Qinisekisa izitshalo ezitholakala enkulisa manje nokusebenza kwazo endaweni.
entries.st: Afri-Star ke mofuta o hlahisitsweng ke ARC o hlokang ho bata ho fokolang, o nang le tlhoko e boletsweng ya 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; matsatsi a wona a {month12}–{month1} a fumanehile Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape mme a hloka ho hlahlojwa dibakeng tse ding. Granny Smith e na le tshupiso ya ho qala ho kga Elgin mafelong a {month3}; SAPO e bolela Golden Delicious kapa Hillieri e le balekane ba peo. Tsena ke ditshupiso tsa mefuta e arohaneng, ha se nako e tswelang pele ya ho kga kapa keletso bakeng sa KZN e futhumetseng. Netefatsa dimela tse fumanehang hajwale keretjheng le tshebetso ya lehae.
entries.ts: Afri-Star i muxaka lowu humesiweke hi ARC lowu lavaka ku titimela kutsongo, lowu nga ni xilaveko lexi vuriweke xa 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; masiku ya wona ya {month12}–{month1} ma kumeke eBien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape naswona ma fanele ku kambisisiwa endhawini kunwana. Granny Smith yi ni xikombo xa ku sungula ku kha eElgin ekuheleni ka {month3}; SAPO yi vula Golden Delicious kumbe Hillieri ku va vanghana va mpova. Swikombo leswi i swa mixaka yo hambana, a hi nguva yo kha leyi nga heriki kumbe xitsundzuxo xa KZN yo kufumela. Tiyisisa swimilana leswi nga kona sweswi endhawini yo kurisela ni ndlela leyi swi tirhaka ha yona endhawini.
entries.ve: Afri-Star ndi lushaka lwo bveledzwaho nga ARC lu ṱoḓaho u rothola huṱuku, lu re na ṱhoḓea yo bulwaho ya 300–500 Infruitec Chilling Unit; maḓuvha alwo a {month12}–{month1} o wanala Bien Donne, Simondium, Western Cape nahone a ṱoḓa u sedzulusiwa huṅwe henefho. Granny Smith i na tshiko tsha u thoma u ka Elgin mafheloni a {month3}; SAPO i bula Golden Delicious kana Hillieri sa tshaka dzi ṋeaho luvhanda. Izwi ndi zwiko zwa tshaka dzo fhambanaho, a si tshifhinga tsha u ka tshi sa khauwi kana themendelo ya KZN i dudelaho. Khwaṱhisedzani zwimela zwi re hone zwino kha hune zwa alusiwa na kushumele kwa henefho.

entries.english: Check drainage, water and cultivar/rootstock fit. Main crop timing differs between warm and cool areas; smaller additional crops are not a full-year promise.
entries.zu: Hlola ukuphuma kwamanzi, amanzi nokufaneleka kohlobo/isiphunzi. Isikhathi sesivuno esikhulu siyehluka phakathi kwezindawo ezifudumele nezipholile; izivuno ezincane ezengeziwe azisona isithembiso sonyaka wonke.
entries.st: Hlahloba phallo ya metsi mobung, metsi le ho tshwaneleha ha mofuta/kutu ya motso. Nako ya kotulo e kgolo e fapana dibakeng tse futhumetseng le tse phodileng; dikotulo tse nyane tse eketsehileng ha se tshepiso ya selemo kaofela.
entries.ts: Kambela ku huma ka mati, mati ni ku faneleka ka muxaka/nsinya wa timitsu. Nkarhi wa ntshovelo lowukulu wa hambana etindhawini to kufumela ni to titimela; mintshovelo leyitsongo yo engetela a yi vuli ku tswala lembe hinkwaro.
entries.ve: Ṱolani u bva ha maḓi, maḓi na u tea ha lushaka/mudzi wa mutheo. Tshifhinga tsha khaṋo khulwane tshi fhambana kha fhethu hu dudelaho na hu rotholelaho; khaṋo ṱhukhu dzo engedzeaho a dzi fulufhedzisi ṅwaha woṱhe.

entries.english: Request labelled lemon stock and rootstock advice from a reputable citrus nursery. A locally validated named cultivar shortlist is not established here.
entries.zu: Cela izitshalo zikalamula ezinamalebula nezeluleko zesiphunzi enkulisa yezithelo ezisawolintshi ethembekile. Alukho lapha uhlu olufushane lwezinhlobo eziqanjwe amagama oluqinisekiswe endaweni.
entries.st: Kopa dimela tsa lemon tse nang le dileibole le keletso ya kutu ya motso keretjheng e tshepahalang ya citrus. Ha ho lenane le lekgutshwane la mefuta e bitsitsweng ka mabitso le netefaditsweng sebakeng mona.
entries.ts: Kombela swimilana swa lemon leswi nga ni tilebulu ni switsundzuxo swa nsinya wa timitsu eka ndhawu yo kurisela citrus leyi tivekaka. A ku na nxaxamelo wo koma wa mixaka leyi nga ni mavito leyi tiyisisiweke endhawini laha.
entries.ve: Humbelani zwimela zwa lemon zwi re na ḽebuḽu na nyeletshedzo ya mudzi wa mutheo kha hune ha alusiwa citrus hu fulufhedzeaho. A hu na mutevhe mupfufhi wa tshaka dzo bulwaho nga madzina wo khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho afha.

entries.english: Match warm summers with cool, frost-free winter conditions for flowering; protect from wind and keep young plants watered.
entries.zu: Hlanganisa ihlobo elifudumele nobusika obupholile obungenasithwathwa ukuze kuqhakaze; vikela emoyeni futhi unisele izitshalo ezisencane.
entries.st: Nyalanya lehlabula le futhumetseng le mariha a phodileng a se nang leqhwa bakeng sa ho thunya; sireletsa moyeng mme o nosetse dimela tse nyane.
entries.ts: Fananisa ximumu xo kufumela ni xixika xo titimela lexi nga riki na gwitsi leswaku ku ta huma swiluva; sirhelela eka moya naswona u cheleta swimilana leswitsongo.
entries.ve: Fananyisani tshilimo tshi dudelaho na vhuriha vhu rotholelaho vhu si na ṅwando uri hu vhe na maluvha; tsireledzani kha muya ni sheledze zwimela zwiṱuku.

entries.english: KZN candidates: earlier Fay Zee Siu (mid-November–mid-December), middle Mauritius (mid-November–early-January), later Wai Chee (end-January–end-February), using SALGA/ARC cultivar references. Confirm local dates, nursery stock and flowering conditions.
entries.zu: Izinhlobo ezingacatshangelwa e-KZN: i-Fay Zee Siu yokuqala (maphakathi no-{month11}–maphakathi no-{month12}), i-Mauritius yaphakathi (maphakathi no-{month11}–ekuqaleni kuka-{month1}), i-Wai Chee yakamuva (ekupheleni kuka-{month1}–ekupheleni kuka-{month2}), ngokwezinkomba zezinhlobo ze-SALGA/ARC. Qinisekisa izinsuku zendawo, izitshalo ezitholakala enkulisa nezimo zokuqhakaza.
entries.st: Mefuta e ka nahanelwang KZN: Fay Zee Siu ya pele (bohareng ba {month11}–bohareng ba {month12}), Mauritius ya bohareng (bohareng ba {month11}–qalong ya {month1}), Wai Chee ya morao (mafelong a {month1}–mafelong a {month2}), ho sebediswa ditshupiso tsa mefuta tsa SALGA/ARC. Netefatsa matsatsi a lehae, dimela tse fumanehang keretjheng le maemo a ho thunya.
entries.ts: Mixaka leyi nga kambisisiwaka eKZN: Fay Zee Siu yo sungula (exikarhini ka {month11}–exikarhini ka {month12}), Mauritius ya le xikarhini (exikarhini ka {month11}–eku sunguleni ka {month1}), Wai Chee ya le ndzhaku (ekuheleni ka {month1}–ekuheleni ka {month2}), hi ku tirhisa swikombo swa mixaka swa SALGA/ARC. Tiyisisa masiku ya ndhawu, swimilana leswi kumekaka endhawini yo kurisela ni swiyimo swa ku huma ka swiluva.
entries.ve: Tshaka dzi nga sedzuluswaho kha KZN: Fay Zee Siu ya u thoma (vhukati ha {month11}–vhukati ha {month12}), Mauritius ya vhukati (vhukati ha {month11}–mathomoni a {month1}), Wai Chee ya murahu (mafheloni a {month1}–mafheloni a {month2}), hu tshi shumiswa zwiko zwa tshaka zwa SALGA/ARC. Khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha a henefho, zwimela zwi re hone hune zwa alusiwa na nyimele dza maluvha.

entries.english: Provide trellising and pruning; avoid waterlogging and inspect for root rot and virus problems.
entries.zu: Faka izisekelo zokukhuphuka futhi uthene; gwema ukugcwala kwamanzi uhlole ukubola kwezimpande nezinkinga zamagciwane.
entries.st: Fana ka ditshehetso tsa ho hloa le ho faola; qoba mobu o tletseng metsi mme o hlahlobe ho bola ha metso le mathata a divaerase.
entries.ts: Nyika swiseketelo swo khandziya ni ku thena; papalata misava leyi taleke mati naswona u kambela ku bola ka timitsu ni swiphiqo swa tivhayirasi.
entries.ve: Ṋeani zwitikedzi zwa u gonya ni rune; iledzani mavu o ḓalaho maḓi ni ṱole u sina ha midzi na thaidzo dza vairasi.

entries.english: Purple granadilla is the KZN fresh-fruit reference; yellow forms are more acidic and used for juice. Confirm stock health and local season.
entries.zu: I-purple granadilla iyireferensi yezithelo ezintsha yase-KZN; izinhlobo eziphuzi zimuncu kakhulu futhi zisetshenziselwa ujusi. Qinisekisa impilo yezitshalo nesikhathi sendawo.
entries.st: Purple granadilla ke tshupiso ya ditholwana tse foreshe ya KZN; mefuta e tshehla e bodila ho feta mme e sebedisetswa jusi. Netefatsa bophelo ba dimela le nako ya lehae.
entries.ts: Purple granadilla i xikombo xa mihandzu leyintshwa xa KZN; mixaka ya xitshopana yi ni asidi yo tala naswona yi tirhisiwa eka juzi. Tiyisisa rihanyo ra swimilana ni nguva ya ndhawu.
entries.ve: Purple granadilla ndi tshiko tsha mitshelo mivhisi tsha KZN; tshaka dza ṱaḓa dzi na asidi nnzhi nahone dzi shumiswa kha dzhuisi. Khwaṱhisedzani mutakalo wa zwimela na tshifhinga tsha henefho.

entries.english: Match the vineyard variety to its production region, water and support system. The national supply season combines several regions.
entries.zu: Khetha uhlobo lwesivini oluhambisana nesifunda sokukhiqiza, amanzi nohlelo lokusekela. Isikhathi sikazwelonke sokuhlinzeka sihlanganisa izifunda eziningana.
entries.st: Nyalanya mofuta wa serapa sa morara le sebaka sa tlhahiso, metsi le tsamaiso ya tshehetso. Nako ya phepelo ya naha e kopanya dibaka tse mmalwa.
entries.ts: Fananisa muxaka wa nsimu ya madiriva ni ndhawu ya vuhumelerisi, mati ni sisiteme yo seketela. Nguva ya mphakelo wa tiko yi hlanganisa tindhawu to tala.
entries.ve: Fananyisani lushaka lwa tsimu ya nḓirivhe na dzingu ḽa u bveledza, maḓi na maitele a u tikedza. Tshifhinga tsha mphakelo wa lushaka tshi ṱanganya madzingu manzhi.

entries.english: DAFF industry reference: earlier Prime Seedless, Sugraone and Flame Seedless; later Dauphine and Crimson Seedless. SATI identifies Orange River choices including Prime, Thompson Seedless and Sugraone. Confirm local dates and stock; the industry sequence is not a KZN farm calendar.
entries.zu: Ireferensi yezimboni ye-DAFF: i-Prime Seedless, i-Sugraone ne-Flame Seedless zakuqala; i-Dauphine ne-Crimson Seedless zakamuva. I-SATI ibala izinketho zase-Orange River ezihlanganisa i-Prime, i-Thompson Seedless ne-Sugraone. Qinisekisa izinsuku nezitshalo ezitholakala endaweni; ukulandelana kwezimboni akulona ikhalenda lepulazi lase-KZN.
entries.st: Tshupiso ya indasteri ya DAFF: Prime Seedless, Sugraone le Flame Seedless tsa pele; Dauphine le Crimson Seedless tsa morao. SATI e bolela dikgetho tsa Orange River tse kenyelletsang Prime, Thompson Seedless le Sugraone. Netefatsa matsatsi le dimela tsa lehae; tatellano ya indasteri ha se khalendara ya polasi ya KZN.
entries.ts: Xikombo xa indasitiri xa DAFF: Prime Seedless, Sugraone na Flame Seedless to sungula; Dauphine na Crimson Seedless ta le ndzhaku. SATI yi vula mixaka ya Orange River leyi katsaka Prime, Thompson Seedless na Sugraone. Tiyisisa masiku ni swimilana swa ndhawu; ku landzelana ka indasitiri a hi khalendara ya purasi ra KZN.
entries.ve: Tshiko tsha indasṱiri tsha DAFF: Prime Seedless, Sugraone na Flame Seedless dza u thoma; Dauphine na Crimson Seedless dza murahu. SATI i bula tshaka dza Orange River dzi katelaho Prime, Thompson Seedless na Sugraone. Khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha na zwimela zwa henefho; u tevhekana ha indasṱiri a si khalenda ya bulasi ḽa KZN.

entries.english: Use clean runners and match the variety and production system to the area. Reliable irrigation and disease control matter.
entries.zu: Sebenzisa amahlumela anokwebeka ahlanzekile, ukhethe uhlobo nohlelo lokukhiqiza olufanele indawo. Ukunisela okuthembekile nokulawula izifo kubalulekile.
entries.st: Sebedisa mahlomela a hahabang a hlwekileng mme o nyalanye mofuta le tsamaiso ya tlhahiso le sebaka. Ho nosetsa ho tshepahalang le taolo ya mafu di bohlokwa.
entries.ts: Tirhisa swihluke leswi navaka leswi baseke naswona u fananisa muxaka ni sisiteme ya vuhumelerisi ni ndhawu. Ku cheleta loku tiyisekaka ni ku lawula mavabyi i swa nkoka.
entries.ve: Shumisani matavhi a navhaho o kunaho ni fananyise lushaka na maitele a u bveledza na fhethu. U sheledza hu fulufhedzeaho na u langa malwadze ndi zwa ndeme.

entries.english: KZN guide names Chandler and Selecta. Current local availability and performance need checking; tunnel and outdoor seasons must remain separate.
entries.zu: Umhlahlandlela wase-KZN ubala i-Chandler ne-Selecta. Ukutholakala nokusebenza kwazo endaweni manje kudinga ukuhlolwa; izikhathi zasemhubheni nezangaphandle mazihlale zehlukene.
entries.st: Tataiso ya KZN e bolela Chandler le Selecta. Ho fumaneha le tshebetso ya tsona ya hajwale sebakeng di hloka ho hlahlojwa; dinako tsa ka tonneleng le tsa ka ntle di lokela ho dula di arohane.
entries.ts: Nkongomiso wa KZN wu vula Chandler na Selecta. Ku kumeka ni matirhelo ya swona sweswi endhawini swi lava ku kambisisiwa; tinguva ta le tunnel ni ta le handle ti fanele ku hambana.
entries.ve: Nyendedzi ya KZN i bula Chandler na Selecta. U wanala na kushumele kwadzo kwa zwino henefho zwi ṱoḓa u sedzulusiwa; zwifhinga zwa nga ngomu ha thaneḽe na zwa nnḓa zwi dzule zwo fhambana.

entries.english: Fruit: record whole fruit separately from arils or juice.
entries.zu: Izithelo: bhala izithelo eziphelele ngokwehlukana nezinhlamvu ezinenyama noma ujusi.
entries.st: Ditholwana: ngola ditholwana tse feletseng ka thoko ho dithollo tse nang le nama kapa jusi.
entries.ts: Mihandzu: rhekhoda mihandzu leyi heleleke yi hambanile ni tindzoho leti nga ni nyama kumbe juzi.
entries.ve: Mitshelo: rekhodani mitshelo yo fhelelaho yo fhambana na mbeu dzi re na ṋama kana dzhuisi.

entries.english: Check fruit maturity and post-harvest handling. Sunburn, cracking and rot vary by cultivar.
entries.zu: Hlola ukuvuthwa kwezithelo nokuphathwa kwazo emva kokuvuna. Ukushiswa yilanga, ukuqhekeka nokubola kuyehluka ngezinhlobo.
entries.st: Hlahloba ho butswa ha ditholwana le tlhokomelo ya tsona ka mora kotulo. Ho tjheswa ke letsatsi, ho petsoha le ho bola di fapana ka mefuta.
entries.ts: Kambela ku vupfa ka mihandzu ni ku yi khoma endzhaku ka ntshovelo. Ku hisiwa hi dyambu, ku pandzeka ni ku bola swa hambana hi mixaka.
entries.ve: Ṱolani u vhibva ha mitshelo na u i fara nga murahu ha khaṋo. U swa nga ḓuvha, u phatsha na u sina zwi fhambana nga tshaka.

entries.english: Wonderful is an SA industry cultivar. Treat it as a candidate, not proof of fit for a humid KZN site; no locally validated early/middle succession is sourced here.
entries.zu: I-Wonderful iwuhlobo olusetshenziswa embonini yaseNingizimu Afrika. Yibheke njengengacatshangelwa, hhayi ubufakazi bokufaneleka kwendawo yase-KZN enomswakama; alukho lapha uhlelo lwezinhlobo zokuqala/zaphakathi oluqinisekiswe endaweni.
entries.st: Wonderful ke mofuta wa indasteri ya Afrika Borwa. E nke e le e ka nahanelwang, eseng bopaki ba ho tshwaneleha sebakeng se mongobo sa KZN; ha ho tatellano ya pele/bohareng e netefaditsweng sebakeng e fuweng mohlodi mona.
entries.ts: Wonderful i muxaka wa indasitiri ya Afrika-Dzonga. Wu teki wu ri lowu nga kambisisiwaka, ku nga ri vumbhoni bya leswaku wu faneleka eka ndhawu ya KZN leyi nga ni ndzhongho; a ku na ku landzelana ka mixaka yo sungula/ya le xikarhini loku tiyisisiweke endhawini loku sekeriweke eka xihlovo laha.
entries.ve: Wonderful ndi lushaka lwa indasṱiri ya Afurika Tshipembe. Lu dzhieni sa lu nga sedzuluswaho, hu si vhuṱanzi ha u tea kha fhethu ha KZN hu re na muṋo; a hu na u tevhekana ha tshaka dza u thoma/vhukati ho khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho ho wanalaho kha tshiko afha.

entries.english: Leaves and green pods; keep their records separate.
entries.zu: Amaqabunga nemidumba eluhlaza; gcina amarekhodi ako ehlukene.
entries.st: Mahlaku le diphotlwa tse tala; boloka direkoto tsa tsona di arohane.
entries.ts: Matluka ni tinyawa ta le swiphotlweni ta rihlaza; hlayisa tirhekhodo ta swona ti hambanile.
entries.ve: Maṱari na maganda a mbeu madala; vhulungani rekhodo dzazwo dzo fhambana.

entries.english: Choose a sunny, well-drained growing position, protect establishment and plan pruning for leaf harvest.
entries.zu: Khetha indawo yokukhula enelanga ekhipha amanzi kahle, vikela ukusimama kwesitshalo bese uhlela ukuthenela ukuvuna amaqabunga.
entries.st: Kgetha sebaka sa ho hola se nang le letsatsi se ntshang metsi hantle, sireletsa ho mela ha semela mme o rere ho faola bakeng sa kotulo ya mahlaku.
entries.ts: Hlawula ndhawu yo kula leyi nga ni dyambu ni ku huma ka mati kahle, sirhelela ku sungula ku kula kutani u pulana ku thena leswaku ku tshoveriwa matluka.
entries.ve: Nangani fhethu ha u aluwa hu re na ḓuvha hu bvumisaho maḓi zwavhuḓi, tsireledzani u thoma u aluwa ni pulane u runela u kaṋa maṱari.

entries.english: Use correctly identified local planting material. No locally validated named cultivar shortlist is sourced; this plan does not claim nitrogen fixation or medicinal effects.
entries.zu: Sebenzisa izinto zokutshala zendawo ezikhonjwe kahle. Alukho uhlu olufushane lwezinhlobo eziqanjwe amagama oluqinisekiswe endaweni olunomthombo; lolu hlelo alusho ukuthi isitshalo sibopha i-nitrogen noma siyelapha.
entries.st: Sebedisa thepa ya ho jala ya lehae e tsejwang ka nepo. Ha ho lenane le lekgutshwane la mefuta e nang le mabitso le netefaditsweng sebakeng le nang le mohlodi; moralo ona ha o bolele hore semela se tlamella nitrogen kapa se na le diphello tsa bongaka.
entries.ts: Tirhisa switirhisiwa swo byala swa ndhawu leswi tivekaka kahle. A ku na nxaxamelo wo koma wa mixaka leyi nga ni mavito leyi tiyisisiweke endhawini leyi nga ni xihlovo; pulani leyi a yi vuli leswaku ximilana xi khoma nitrogen kumbe xi ni ku tirha ka vutshunguri.
entries.ve: Shumisani zwishumiswa zwa u ṱavha zwa henefho zwo ṱaluswaho zwavhuḓi. A hu na mutevhe mupfufhi wa tshaka dzo bulwaho nga madzina wo khwaṱhisedzwaho henefho u re na tshiko; pulane iyi a i buli u vhofha nitrogen kana mvelelo dza dzilafho.

entries.english: Soft citrus generally favours cooler, drier conditions. Confirm rootstock and pollination/seediness requirements before mixing varieties.
entries.zu: Izithelo ezisawolintshi ezithambile zivame ukuthanda izimo ezipholile nezomile. Qinisekisa izidingo zesiphunzi nempova/ukuba nezinhlamvu ngaphambi kokuxuba izinhlobo.
entries.st: Ditholwana tsa citrus tse bonolo hangata e rata maemo a phodileng, a ommeng. Netefatsa ditlhoko tsa kutu ya motso le ho tsamaisa peo/ho ba le dipeo pele o kopanya mefuta.
entries.ts: Mihandzu ya citrus yo olova yi tala ku tsakela swiyimo swo titimela ni swo oma. Tiyisisa swilaveko swa nsinya wa timitsu ni mpova/ku va ni timbewu u nga si hlanganisa mixaka.
entries.ve: Mitshelo ya citrus yo leluwaho i anzela u takalela nyimele dzi rotholelaho dzo omaho. Khwaṱhisedzani ṱhoḓea dza mudzi wa mutheo na luvhanda/u vha na mbeu musi ni sa athu ṱanganya tshaka.

entries.english: For a suitable site: early Miho Wase satsuma (from mid-March); middle clementines (late March–mid-June); later Nadorcott mandarin (mid-May–September). Dates are broad SA references, not a local calendar. Order labelled nursery trees.
entries.zu: Endaweni efanelekile: i-Miho Wase satsuma yokuqala (kusukela maphakathi no-{month3}); ama-clementines aphakathi (ekupheleni kuka-{month3}–maphakathi no-{month6}); i-Nadorcott mandarin yakamuva (maphakathi no-{month5}–{month9}). Izinsuku ziyizinkomba ezibanzi zaseNingizimu Afrika, azilona ikhalenda lendawo. Oda izihlahla zasenkulisa ezinamalebula.
entries.st: Bakeng sa sebaka se loketseng: Miho Wase satsuma ya pele (ho tloha bohareng ba {month3}); clementines tsa bohareng (mafelong a {month3}–bohareng ba {month6}); Nadorcott mandarin ya morao (bohareng ba {month5}–{month9}). Matsatsi ke ditshupiso tse batsi tsa Afrika Borwa, ha se khalendara ya lehae. Odara difate tsa keretjhe tse nang le dileibole.
entries.ts: Eka ndhawu leyi faneleke: Miho Wase satsuma yo sungula (ku sukela exikarhini ka {month3}); clementines ta le xikarhini (ekuheleni ka {month3}–exikarhini ka {month6}); Nadorcott mandarin ya le ndzhaku (exikarhini ka {month5}–{month9}). Masiku i swikombo swo anama swa Afrika-Dzonga, a hi khalendara ya ndhawu. Oda mirhi ya ndhawu yo kurisela leyi nga ni tilebulu.
entries.ve: Kha fhethu ho teaho: Miho Wase satsuma ya u thoma (u bva vhukati ha {month3}); clementines dza vhukati (mafheloni a {month3}–vhukati ha {month6}); Nadorcott mandarin ya murahu (vhukati ha {month5}–{month9}). Maḓuvha ndi zwiko zwo angalalaho zwa Afurika Tshipembe, a si khalenda ya henefho. Odarani miri ya hune ya alusiwa i re na ḽebuḽu.

entries.english: Check chilling, support and pruning system before planting. Autumn-bearing varieties must not inherit a spring-bearing calendar.
entries.zu: Hlola ukubanda, izisekelo nohlelo lokuthena ngaphambi kokutshala. Izinhlobo ezithela ekwindla mazingazuzi ikhalenda lezinhlobo ezithela entwasahlobo.
entries.st: Hlahloba ho bata, tshehetso le tsamaiso ya ho faola pele o jala. Mefuta e behang ditholwana ka hwetla ha e a lokela ho fuwa khalendara ya mefuta e behang nakong ya selemo.
entries.ts: Kambela ku titimela, swiseketelo ni sisiteme yo thena u nga si byala. Mixaka leyi tswalaka hi xixikana a yi fanelanga ku kuma khalendara ya leyi tswalaka hi ximunwana.
entries.ve: Ṱolani u rothola, zwitikedzi na maitele a u runa musi ni sa athu ṱavha. Tshaka dzi aṋwaho nga tshifhefho dzi songo fhiwa khalenda ya dzi aṋwaho nga lutavula.

entries.english: KZN guide: low-chill autumn bearers Heritage or Autumn Bliss; spring bearers Glen Prosen, Glen Lyon or Tulameen need more chilling. Confirm local dates.
entries.zu: Umhlahlandlela wase-KZN: izinhlobo ezithela ekwindla ezingadingi ukubanda okuningi i-Heritage noma i-Autumn Bliss; ezithela entwasahlobo i-Glen Prosen, i-Glen Lyon noma i-Tulameen zidinga ukubanda okuningi. Qinisekisa izinsuku zendawo.
entries.st: Tataiso ya KZN: Heritage kapa Autumn Bliss di beha ka hwetla mme di hloka ho bata ho fokolang; Glen Prosen, Glen Lyon kapa Tulameen tse behang nakong ya selemo di hloka ho bata ho feta. Netefatsa matsatsi a lehae.
entries.ts: Nkongomiso wa KZN: Heritage kumbe Autumn Bliss ti tswala hi xixikana naswona ti lava ku titimela kutsongo; Glen Prosen, Glen Lyon kumbe Tulameen leti tswalaka hi ximunwana ti lava ku titimela ko tala. Tiyisisa masiku ya ndhawu.
entries.ve: Nyendedzi ya KZN: Heritage kana Autumn Bliss dzi aṋwa nga tshifhefho nahone dzi ṱoḓa u rothola huṱuku; Glen Prosen, Glen Lyon kana Tulameen dzi aṋwaho nga lutavula dzi ṱoḓa u rothola hunzhi. Khwaṱhisedzani maḓuvha a henefho.

entries.english: Check soil acidity, cultivar chilling, irrigation and pollination requirements before buying.
entries.zu: Hlola ubumuncu bomhlabathi, ukubanda okudingwa uhlobo, ukunisela nezidingo zempova ngaphambi kokuthenga.
entries.st: Hlahloba bodila ba mobu, ho bata ho hlokwang ke mofuta, ho nosetsa le ditlhoko tsa ho tsamaisa peo pele o reka.
entries.ts: Kambela asidi ya misava, ku titimela loku laviwaka hi muxaka, ku cheleta ni swilaveko swa mpova u nga si xava.
entries.ve: Ṱolani asidi ya mavu, u rothola hu ṱoḓwaho nga lushaka, u sheledza na ṱhoḓea dza luvhanda musi ni sa athu renga.

entries.english: Warm-climate candidate: Biloxi, a low-chill southern highbush cultivar, reported by a nursery producing stock in South Africa. Obtain a compatible southern highbush pollination partner. Early flowering can suffer spring frost; local soil, chill and harvest dates still need checking. Do not substitute rabbiteye plants as a highbush cultivar.
entries.zu: Uhlobo olungacatshangelwa esimweni sezulu esifudumele: Biloxi, uhlobo lwe-southern highbush olungadingi ukubanda okuningi, olubikwe yinkulisa ekhiqiza izitshalo eNingizimu Afrika. Thola olunye uhlobo lwe-southern highbush oluhambisanayo lwempova. Ukuqhakaza kusenesikhathi kungalinyazwa isithwathwa sasentwasahlobo; umhlabathi, ukubanda nezinsuku zokuvuna zendawo kusadinga ukuhlolwa. Ungasebenzisi izitshalo ze-rabbiteye esikhundleni sohlobo lwe-highbush.
entries.st: Mofuta o ka nahanelwang bakeng sa boemo bo futhumetseng: Biloxi, mofuta wa southern highbush o hlokang ho bata ho fokolang, o tlalehilweng ke keretjhe e hlahisang dimela Afrika Borwa. Fumana molekane wa southern highbush o dumellanang bakeng sa ho tsamaisa peo. Ho thunya kapele ho ka angwa ke serame se bakang leqhwa nakong ya selemo; mobu, ho bata le matsatsi a kotulo a lehae di ntse di hloka ho hlahlojwa. O se ke wa nkela mofuta wa highbush sebaka ka dimela tsa rabbiteye.
entries.ts: Muxaka lowu nga kambisisiwaka eka maxelo yo kufumela: Biloxi, muxaka wa southern highbush lowu lavaka ku titimela kutsongo, lowu vikiweke hi ndhawu yo kurisela swimilana eAfrika-Dzonga. Kuma muxaka wa southern highbush lowu fambisanaka na wona eka mpova. Swiluva swa le ku sunguleni swi nga khumbiwa hi gwitsi ra ximunwana; misava, ku titimela ni masiku ya ntshovelo ya ndhawu swa ha lava ku kambisisiwa. U nga sivi muxaka wa highbush hi swimilana swa rabbiteye.
entries.ve: Lushaka lu nga sedzuluswaho kha kilima i dudelaho: Biloxi, lushaka lwa southern highbush lu ṱoḓaho u rothola huṱuku, lwo vhigwaho nga hune ha alusiwa zwimela Afurika Tshipembe. Wanani lushaka lwa southern highbush lu tshimbidzanaho nalwo kha luvhanda. Maluvha a u ṱavhanya a nga kwamiwa nga ṅwando wa lutavula; mavu, u rothola na maḓuvha a khaṋo a henefho zwi kha ḓi ṱoḓa u sedzulusiwa. Ni songo dzhiela lushaka lwa highbush vhudzulo nga zwimela zwa rabbiteye.

entries.english: Use compatible pollen-shedding and receptive varieties. Wet-summer areas need scab-resistant choices; early nut maturity alone does not establish pollination compatibility.
entries.zu: Sebenzisa izinhlobo ezikhipha impova neziyemukelayo ezihambisanayo. Izindawo ezinemvula yasehlobo zidinga izinhlobo ezimelana nesifo se-scab; ukuvuthwa kwamantongomane kusenesikhathi kukodwa akuqinisekisi ukuhambisana kwempova.
entries.st: Sebedisa mefuta e dumellanang e ntshang le e amohelang peo. Dibaka tse nang le pula hlabula di hloka mefuta e hanyetsang lefu la scab; ho butswa ha matokomane kapele feela ha ho netefatse ho dumellana ha peo.
entries.ts: Tirhisa mixaka leyi humesaka ni ku amukela mpova leyi fambisanaka. Tindhawu leti nga ni mpfula hi ximumu ti lava mixaka leyi lwisanaka ni vuvabyi bya scab; ku vupfa ka timanga hi ku hatlisa ntsena a swi tiyisisi ku fambisana eka mpova.
entries.ve: Shumisani tshaka dzi tshimbidzanaho dzi bvisaho na dzi ṱanganedzaho luvhanda. Madzingu a re na mvula tshilimo a ṱoḓa tshaka dzi konḓelelaho vhulwadze ha scab; u vhibva ha nḓuhu nga u ṱavhanya hu hoṱhe a hu khwaṱhisedzi u tshimbidzana kha luvhanda.

entries.english: SAPPA shortlist: wetter KZN/Lowveld — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; wet, colder KZN — Barton; drier Highveld — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; dry western areas — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. The inferred climate group alone cannot distinguish all these areas. Confirm local humidity, soils and the pollination pair before buying.
entries.zu: Uhlu olufushane lwe-SAPPA: e-KZN/Lowveld enomswakama omningi — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; e-KZN emanzi nebandayo kakhulu — Barton; e-Highveld eyomile kakhudlwana — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; ezindaweni ezomile zasentshonalanga — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Iqembu lesimo sezulu elicatshangelwe lodwa alikwazi ukuhlukanisa zonke lezi zindawo. Qinisekisa umswakama wendawo, umhlabathi nezinhlobo ezimbili zempova ngaphambi kokuthenga.
entries.st: Lenane le lekgutshwane la SAPPA: KZN/Lowveld e nang le mongobo o mongata — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; KZN e metsi, e batang ho feta — Barton; Highveld e ommeng ho feta — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; dibaka tse ommeng tsa bophirimela — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Sehlopha sa maemo a lehodimo se hakantsweng feela ha se kgone ho kgetholla dibaka tsena tsohle. Netefatsa mongobo wa lehae, mobu le balekane ba peo pele o reka.
entries.ts: Nxaxamelo wo koma wa SAPPA: KZN/Lowveld leyi nga ni ndzhongho wo tala — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; KZN leyi tsakamaka, leyi titimelaka swinene — Barton; Highveld leyi omeke ku tlurisa — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; tindhawu to oma ta le vupeladyambu — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Ntlawa wa maxelo lowu kumbeteriweke wu ri woxe a wu koti ku hambanisa tindhawu leti hinkwato. Tiyisisa ndzhongho wa ndhawu, misava ni mixaka yimbirhi ya mpova u nga si xava.
entries.ve: Mutevhe mupfufhi wa SAPPA: KZN/Lowveld hu re na muṋo munzhi — Ukulinga, Cape Fear, Choctaw; KZN hu ṋukalaho, hu rotholelaho nga maanḓa — Barton; Highveld ho omaho nga maanḓa — Barton, Pawnee, Wichita; fhethu ho omaho ha vhukovhela — Wichita, Choctaw, Western Schley. Tshigwada tsha kilima tsho humbulelwaho tshi tshoṱhe a tshi koni u fhambanya fhethu hoṱhe uhu. Khwaṱhisedzani muṋo wa henefho, mavu na tshaka mbili dza luvhanda musi ni sa athu renga.

entries.english: Research checked 11 October 2026. Buy only proposed stock after checking local suitability. Existing plants and structures are inventory, not repeat purchases. Early/middle/late describes picking order; compatible flowering is a separate pollination check. Expected seasons describe established production, not guaranteed food this year.
entries.zu: Ucwaningo lwahlolwa ngo-11 {month10} 2026. Thenga kuphela izitshalo noma izilwane ezihleliwe emva kokuhlola ukufaneleka kwendawo. Izitshalo nezakhiwo ezikhona ziyirekhodi lokukhona, akuzona ezizophinde zithengwe. Okokuqala/okuphakathi/okwakamuva kuchaza ukulandelana kokukha; ukuhambisana kokuqhakaza kuwukuhlola kwempova okuhlukile. Izikhathi ezilindelekile zichaza ukukhiqiza osekusimeme, akukhona ukudla okuqinisekisiwe kulo nyaka.
entries.st: Patlisiso e hlahlobilwe ka 11 {month10} 2026. Reka feela dimela kapa diphoofolo tse rerilweng ka mora ho hlahloba ho tshwaneleha ha sebaka. Dimela le meaho e seng e le teng ke direkoto tsa thepa, ha se tse lokelang ho rekwa hape. Pele/bohareng/morao ho hlalosa tatellano ya ho kga; ho thunya ho dumellanang ke tlhahlobo e arohaneng ya ho tsamaisa peo. Dinako tse lebelletsweng di hlalosa tlhahiso e seng e tsitsitse, ha se dijo tse tiisitsweng selemong sena.
entries.ts: Ndzavisiso wu kamberiwile hi 11 {month10} 2026. Xava ntsena swimilana kumbe swifuwo leswi pulaniweke endzhaku ko kambela ku faneleka endhawini. Swimilana ni miako leswi nga kona i nhundzu leyi rhekhodiweke, a hi leswi faneleke ku xaviwa nakambe. Ku sungula/xikarhini/ndzhaku swi hlamusela ku landzelana ka ku kha; ku huma swiluva loku fambisanaka i nkambelo wunwana wa mpova. Tinguva leti languteriweke ti hlamusela vuhumelerisi bya leswi se swi kurile, a ti tiyisisi swakudya lembe leri.
entries.ve: Ṱhoḓisiso yo sedzuluswa nga 11 {month10} 2026. Rengani fhedzi zwimela kana zwifuwo zwo dzudzanywaho nga murahu ha u ṱola u tea henefho. Zwimela na zwifhaṱo zwi re hone ndi thundu yo rekhodiwaho, a si zwine zwa tea u rengululwa. U thoma/vhukati/murahu zwi ṱalutshedza u tevhekana ha u ka; u tshimbidzana ha maluvha ndi u ṱola luvhanda ho fhambanaho. Zwifhinga zwo lavhelelwaho zwi ṱalutshedza u bveledza ho no khwaṱhaho, a zwi fulufhedzisi zwiḽiwa ṅwaha uyu.
